skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize and measure the randomness of events using probability measures and formulas.
Explain basic concepts such as trial, event, sample space, and probability measure.
Differentiate between event relationships and represent events accordingly.
Remember methods to calculate probabilities including classical, statistical, and geometric definitions.
Understand and apply conditional probability and Bayes' theorem.
Explain random variables and probability distributions.
Differentiate and relate univariate random variable functions such as cumulative distribution function, density function, and characteristic function.
Differentiate and relate multivariate random variable functions and conditional probability distributions.
Calculate parameters of univariate, multivariate, and conditional random variables.
Explain special functions like characteristic function and moment generating function.
Classify and compare common discrete and continuous probability distributions.
Explain convergence of random variables and central limit theorem.
Apply probability theory in economic and financial modeling.
Demonstrate self-learning and active engagement in understanding, studying, and solving practical problems.
